= Link fallback text

== URL and link macros

Bare URL: https://bare.example/path

URL macro: https://url.example/path[]

Link macro: link:https://link.example/path[]

Link macro with mailto target: link:mailto:linked@example.com[]

Custom URL text: https://custom.example/path[Custom URL]

Custom link text: link:https://custom.example/path[Custom link]

== Email links

Bare email: bare@example.com

Mailto macro: mailto:macro@example.com[]

Custom mailto text: mailto:custom@example.com[Custom email]

== Bracketed autolinks

Bracketed URL: <https://bracketed.example/path>

Bracketed email: <bracketed@example.com>

== Cross-references

Forward section reference: <<section-target>>

Forward macro reference: xref:section-target[]

Explicit reference text: <<section-target,Custom section>>

Label reference: <<label-target>>

Untitled target reference: <<untitled-target>>

Unresolved reference: <<missing-target>>

External document: xref:other.adoc[]

External document fragment: xref:other.adoc#part[]

External document with custom text: xref:other.adoc#part[Other part]
